role: Applied Scientist II, Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience (GRAISE)
description: We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain.
